section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 13 ## Accidental Deaths Sex-wise: The percentage of male victims to the total accidental deaths reported during 1977, for the country as a whole was much more than for female victims. The percentage of malee victims in the country as a whole was 64.8 per cent while for the female victims it was only 35.2 per cent. The ratio of male and female victims was 64.7 per cent and 35.3 per cent respectively for the States, 69.0 per cent and 31.0 per cent respectively for the Union Territories and 63.6 per cent and 36.4 per cent respectively for the Metropolitan Cities.
